title: TestFlight lane in ios-build.yml (cloud-managed signing, fastlane pilot)
summary: Harness: the macOS stage of ios-build gains a signed lane behind the TESTFLIGHT_ENABLED variable: archive with Xcode cloud-managed signing using the App Store Connect API key, export with method app-store-connect, upload with fastlane pilot; build number = run number; key material removed after the run. gj-qa-release verifies it on the first real run.

acceptance_tests.test: ios-build.yml has an `archive` (unsigned) lane when TESTFLIGHT_ENABLED is not true and a `testflight` lane when it is; both feed one `ios build gate` job; the workflow parses and the gate skips green while the Unity project is absent.
acceptance_tests.evidence: workflow file; Actions run on main

acceptance_tests.test: The testflight lane fails fast with a clear message when any of ASC_KEY_ID, ASC_ISSUER_ID, ASC_KEY_P8_BASE64, APPLE_TEAM_ID is missing, and never echoes a key.

First real run (after M0-UNITY-01 and M0-REPO-05): gj-qa-release confirms the build-number path (Info.plist CFBundleVersion) and the upload, records findings in qa/reports/ios-lane.md, and files fixes as a ticket if needed.

history.event: created by the Coordinator (Owner selection of iPhone Duo candidates 1–3 and App Store Connect key confirmation, AUTH #003)

notes: Landed on main by the Coordinator (fast-forward, no PR) on 2026-09-15; unverified until a Unity project exists.
